  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema/registry-item.json",
  "name": "producer-pipeline-flow",
  "type": "registry:block",
  "title": "Pipeline Flow",
  "description": "graph.json rendered by @xyflow/react: one compact components.flow.base-node per step (title, kind, one labeled input and output handle with its port count), one lane label per swim row, the pinned components.flow.edge smoothstep edge between handles, and a read-only shadcn Sheet with the step facts, opened by the step title (a stock SheetTrigger button).",
  "author": "Clossys",
  "dependencies": [
    "@xyflow/react"
  ],
  "registryDependencies": [
    "components.badge",
    "components.button",
    "components.card",
    "components.flow.base-node",
    "components.flow.canvas",
    "components.flow.edge",
    "components.flow.labeled-handle",
    "components.sheet",
    "components.table"
  ],
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "index.tsx",
      "type": "registry:component",
      "target": "studio/sections/producer-pipeline-flow/index.tsx"
    }
  ]
}

element.reason: W6 composition for /producer/pipeline (v4): graph.json rendered by @xyflow/react with compact components.flow.base-node steps (title, kind badge, one labeled handle per side carrying the port count), one lane label per swim row, and the pinned components.flow.edge smoothstep edge from each writer right handle to each reader left handle; positions come from graph.json. Clicking a step opens a read-only stock shadcn Sheet (components.sheet, components.table, components.badge) with its command, input and output files, options, seat (open when unheld) and status; selection state stays inside the section and there is no edit or run control. Places pinned parts only; copy arrives through Writer keys. Composes sections.producer.step-sheet, which is marked not-needed.
